Hello, World

November 22, 2026

This is the first post on my site. I’ll use this space to write about mathematics, computer science, and whatever else I find interesting enough to put into words.

Why a blog?

There’s a certain clarity that comes from writing things down. Even if no one reads this, the act of explaining something forces you to understand it more precisely. A proof you can’t explain is a proof you don’t fully own.

I also just want a place that’s mine — not an algorithmic feed, not a character-limited post. A slow, deliberate place for ideas.

What to expect

Mostly notes on things I’m learning: proof techniques, algorithms, the occasional programming rabbit hole. Probably some math I find beautiful. Maybe some things that have nothing to do with either.

More soon.
